FaultDeckGame-Dev Fault Simulation & Testing

Simulate latency, packet loss, disconnects and partitions as reproducible, automated test scenarios — for game development testing.

Get Started
MVP Plan
中文文档
  • 🎮

    Built for Game Dev Testing

    Scenarios are reproducible today via `--scenario-name` and a stable report hash. Prebuilt game templates (disconnect-on-join, combat packet loss) are on the P2 roadmap.

  • 🧪

    Fault DSL, Backend Decides

    Fault specs (latency / loss / disconnect) validate before any command runs; the backend answers "unsupported" rather than approximating. The YAML DSL and the Toxiproxy / WinDivert backends are planned.

  • 🔁

    Rollback You Can Trust

    Rollback is idempotent — tc "not found" errors are tolerated and foreign root qdiscs are never touched; a leftover FaultDeck qdisc is cleaned up on the next apply. Kill-safe forced rollback (watchdog + lease) is planned (FD-P0-4).

  • 📄

    Reproducible Reports

    JSON reports with injection parameters, timeline, recovery verification and a stable scenario hash for history diff.
